notes.title: 「Sutekina kanojo no tsukurikata」 release date announced
notes.notes:
The sales schedule for 「[b]Sutekina kanojo no tsukurikata[/b]」 has been finalized!

Sales date: April 23rd
The game will be released by our partner, 「[b]HIKARI FIELD[/b]」.


We apologize to our users for the delay in the release.
Thank you for your continued support of Sushi soft.


Sushi soft
https://www.sushi-soft.com/
